def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    m = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    bad = (m < 2500) | (m > 6500)
    fixed = m / 1000.0
    use_fix = bad & fixed.between(2500, 6500)
    m[use_fix] = fixed[use_fix]
    m[bad & ~use_fix] = float('nan')
    df['body_mass_g'] = m
    return df

def answer(df):
    g = df.dropna(subset=['species', 'body_mass_g'])
    s = g.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].sum()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in s.items()}
